sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's preparation suffices; most applicants hold mathematics degrees, but other backgrounds are
considered. Minimum preparation advanced calculus, linear algebra and differential equations; typical
admitted preparation includes two semesters each of real analysis and senior algebra plus another advanced
course. International F1 applicants are eligible. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the linked 2027 GraduateCAS application, complete all four quadrants, request three referees, upload
academic records, and arrange required Math GRE or obtain an approved waiver. No departmental pre-review
is available. Resolve English eligibility; departmental submission deadlines override portal dates. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor consent required by the admissions checklist. Sottile explicitly welcomes prospective students to
contact him and review his student information page. Faculty availability otherwise unconfirmed. [s1] [s26]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
2026-27 Liaison help verified. Program-specific questions may include additional essays; plain text boxes strip
elaborate formatting. Red-asterisk documents required; uploaded files cannot be replaced after submission.
Use Statuses/Check Status for progress. [s5]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Department application link explicitly points to texasam 2027 GraduateCAS. December 15 deadline and
departmental stipend are standing and not explicitly labeled 2027. Central ELP/new assistantship policies
current to 2026. [s1] [s4] [s8]

review; contact math-gstudies@tamu.edu before a late application. The applicant-selected referee due date is

funding deadline published. [s1] [s2] [s6]

eight weeks before the relevant deadline; late results are not assured review. Math GRE waiver requests go to
grad.director.math@tamu.edu with name, application ID and reason. [s1] [s2] [s4]

late April is a decision timeline, not the commitment deadline. [s2]

English requirement [Conflict]
Central current catalog: TOEFL iBT new 4.5 overall/4.0 each (old overall80), Essentials8.5, IELTS6.0, GRE
verbal146 or specified GMAT alternatives. Scores officially reported; English tests valid two years. Math page
retains old TOEFL80, Essentials8.5, IELTS6 and mentions PTE without current central agreement; do not rely on
PTE without confirmation. ETS code6003; no MyBest. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Completed US bachelor's meets central admission language requirement. Department still says all BA years
must be in the US and a US master's is insufficient, whereas central accepts bachelor's or higher. Pending
degree is not explicitly covered. After admission, the department must request Alternative Verification for
registration using official degree-conferral records. For teaching, an all-coursework-in-US bachelor's can
support Alternative Certification; central certification-before-hire rule supersedes the department's loose
first-semester wording. Confirm transfer/study-abroad credits and expected-degree timing. [s1] [s4] [s10]

criteria. Policy on optional general scores in PhD selection is not explicit. [s1] [s2] [s4]

explanation. GMAT is not a substitute. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department advertises $2,350/month; support page specifies nine paid fall/spring months, yielding $21,150
academic-year stipend (calculated). First summer support is guaranteed, but amount not specified; subsequent
summers depend on standing and funds. Tuition/required fees covered for eligible PhD GAs. New university
floor effective October 1 2026 is $2,000/month at 50%FTE, below the advertised departmental rate; neither is
a confirmed Fall 2027 offer. [s6] [s7] [s8] [qrt1]

Years of support [Conflict]
Recruitment page advertises six years in good standing; support page specifies tuition/fees for first11
non-summer semesters and resident-rate eligibility for first21 semesters. Clarify the apparent
six-year/11-semester difference in the offer. [s6] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International doctoral applicants are considered for departmental assistantships. Teaching requires English
certification; a qualifying US bachelor's offers an alternative-certification route. Some
external/program-specific fellowships have citizenship restrictions. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good academic standing, TA duties (tutoring, recitations/labs, grading or own course) and certification.
University50%FTE assistantship is20hours/week; employee insurance eligibility requires at least50%FTE
and4.5months. Tuition/required fees for PhD teaching/research/lecturer assistantships are mandated;
nonresident waivers are requested each semester. FAQ warns admission does not always guarantee funding.
[s2] [s6] [s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate department support application; all qualifying applicants automatically considered unless they
indicate independent/sponsored funding. Department nominates for selected fellowships. [s2] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Carl Pearcy entering fellowships, college merit fellowships, research-grant assistantships/summer support and
centrally nominated Doctoral Research Excellence opportunities. Verify current citizenship conditions and
nomination dates rather than treating historical diversity/LSAMP listings as universal eligibility. [s6] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$114 international; $89 domestic, nonrefundable, per Math PhD page. Central international admissions lists a
$90 university fee plus the separate CAS processing charge; this need not contradict the department's $114
combined figure, but the final 2027 checkout total and CAS component should be confirmed. [s1] [s10]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
Central need waivers require Pell eligibility evidence or McNair verification, emailed to lagarza@tamu.edu with
program/term. These routes generally do not fit an F1 student; no current Math-specific international waiver
established. Ask before paying rather than assume eligibility. [s3] [s10]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's preparation suffices; most applicants hold mathematics degrees, but other backgrounds are
considered. Minimum preparation advanced calculus, linear algebra and differential equations; typical
admitted preparation includes two semesters each of real analysis and senior algebra plus another advanced
course. International F1 applicants are eligible. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the linked 2027 GraduateCAS application, complete all four quadrants, request three referees, upload
academic records, and arrange required Math GRE or obtain an approved waiver. No departmental pre-review
is available. Resolve English eligibility; departmental submission deadlines override portal dates. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor consent required by the admissions checklist. Sottile explicitly welcomes prospective students to
contact him and review his student information page. Faculty availability otherwise unconfirmed. [s1] [s26]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
2026-27 Liaison help verified. Program-specific questions may include additional essays; plain text boxes strip
elaborate formatting. Red-asterisk documents required; uploaded files cannot be replaced after submission.
Use Statuses/Check Status for progress. [s5]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Department application link explicitly points to texasam 2027 GraduateCAS. December 15 deadline and
departmental stipend are standing and not explicitly labeled 2027. Central ELP/new assistantship policies
current to 2026. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
December 15 for fall full consideration, on the standing page linked to the 2027 portal; no explicit year/time or
separate letter grace period given. Submit complete materials by then. Later materials are not guaranteed
review; contact math-gstudies@tamu.edu before a late application. The applicant-selected referee due date is
a reminder, not an extension. [s1] [s2] [s5]

Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Automatic consideration with application; use December 15 full-consideration deadline. No separate initial
funding deadline published. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required scores should arrive for December 15 full consideration. Central catalog recommends testing at least
eight weeks before the relevant deadline; late results are not assured review. Math GRE waiver requests go to
grad.director.math@tamu.edu with name, application ID and reason. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No explicit Fall 2027 offer-acceptance deadline located. First offers usually mid-February; possible later round
late April is a decision timeline, not the commitment deadline. [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Central current catalog: TOEFL iBT new 4.5 overall/4.0 each (old overall80), Essentials8.5, IELTS6.0, GRE
verbal146 or specified GMAT alternatives. Scores officially reported; English tests valid two years. Math page
retains old TOEFL80, Essentials8.5, IELTS6 and mentions PTE without current central agreement; do not rely on
PTE without confirmation. ETS code6003; no MyBest. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Completed US bachelor's meets central admission language requirement. Department still says all BA years
must be in the US and a US master's is insufficient, whereas central accepts bachelor's or higher. Pending
degree is not explicitly covered. After admission, the department must request Alternative Verification for
registration using official degree-conferral records. For teaching, an all-coursework-in-US bachelor's can
support Alternative Certification; central certification-before-hire rule supersedes the department's loose
first-semester wording. Confirm transfer/study-abroad credits and expected-degree timing. [s1] [s4] [s10]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed as required for PhD; required for the separate MS. GRE verbal146 can meet central admission English
criteria. Policy on optional general scores in PhD selection is not explicit. [s1] [s2] [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Required for PhD, within five years of receipt; official ETS6003. Waiver possible for a suitable reason that
prevents completion before deadline; email grad.director.math@tamu.edu with name, application ID and
explanation. GMAT is not a substitute. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Transcripts and degree statements from every senior-level institution; community-college records exempt.
Unofficial copies may be uploaded for review; redact Social Security number. International-language records
need originals plus official English translation. After admission/enrollment intent, official records must reach
Admissions before registration. [s1] [s3]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate required mathematics-course list or descriptions established in the public PhD checklist. Verify live
Program Materials; prerequisites are assessed through transcripts. [s1] [s2]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, written and electronically submitted by the referees themselves, from people able to assess
mathematical ability. [s1]

Completed recommendations cannot be removed/replaced. Re-send a pending request through its edit control.

Personal / background statement [Standing rule]

not publish exact prompt, word limit or format. [s1]
Research-interest statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No distinct requirement, prompt, length or upload/link instruction established from public PhD admissions and
GraduateCAS help. Inspect the live program-specific questions and document slots. [s1] [s5]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate required mathematics-course list or descriptions established in the public PhD checklist. Verify live
Program Materials; prerequisites are assessed through transcripts. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Automatic departmental financial consideration has no separate application. No extra essay specified in the
initial checklist; central nomination awards may request additional materials. [s2] [s6] [s9]

Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department advertises $2,350/month; support page specifies nine paid fall/spring months, yielding $21,150
academic-year stipend (calculated). First summer support is guaranteed, but amount not specified; subsequent
summers depend on standing and funds. Tuition/required fees covered for eligible PhD GAs. New university
floor effective October 1 2026 is $2,000/month at 50%FTE, below the advertised departmental rate; neither is
a confirmed Fall 2027 offer. [s6] [s7] [s8] [qrt1]

Recruitment page advertises six years in good standing; support page specifies tuition/fees for first11
non-summer semesters and resident-rate eligibility for first21 semesters. Clarify the apparent
six-year/11-semester difference in the offer. [s6] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International doctoral applicants are considered for departmental assistantships. Teaching requires English
certification; a qualifying US bachelor's offers an alternative-certification route. Some
external/program-specific fellowships have citizenship restrictions. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good academic standing, TA duties (tutoring, recitations/labs, grading or own course) and certification.
University50%FTE assistantship is20hours/week; employee insurance eligibility requires at least50%FTE
and4.5months. Tuition/required fees for PhD teaching/research/lecturer assistantships are mandated;
nonresident waivers are requested each semester. FAQ warns admission does not always guarantee funding.
[s2] [s6] [s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate department support application; all qualifying applicants automatically considered unless they
indicate independent/sponsored funding. Department nominates for selected fellowships. [s2] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Carl Pearcy entering fellowships, college merit fellowships, research-grant assistantships/summer support and
centrally nominated Doctoral Research Excellence opportunities. Verify current citizenship conditions and
nomination dates rather than treating historical diversity/LSAMP listings as universal eligibility. [s6] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$114 international; $89 domestic, nonrefundable, per Math PhD page. Central international admissions lists a
$90 university fee plus the separate CAS processing charge; this need not contradict the department's $114
combined figure, but the final 2027 checkout total and CAS component should be confirmed. [s1] [s10]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
Central need waivers require Pell eligibility evidence or McNair verification, emailed to lagarza@tamu.edu with
program/term. These routes generally do not fit an F1 student; no current Math-specific international waiver
established. Ask before paying rather than assume eligibility. [s3] [s10]

Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Math and central English policies differ on US master's/degree wording, PTE, new TOEFL scale and timing of
teaching certification. Funding FAQ says admission need not include funding, while support/recruitment pages
describe supported PhDs; obtain written award. Six-year recruitment statement differs from 11-semester
tuition statement. Several old faculty webpages remain after moves/retirement. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s6] [s7] [s27] [s28]

Confirm pending-UChicago-degree English treatment and any non-US coursework; current essay/CV limits and
optional uploads; definitive Fall 2027 deadline time, funding amount and guaranteed summers/duration;
reference amendment/reuse and offer acceptance date. Submit Math GRE or secure written waiver. [s1] [s4] [s5]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's preparation suffices; most applicants hold mathematics degrees, but other backgrounds are
considered. Minimum preparation advanced calculus, linear algebra and differential equations; typical
admitted preparation includes two semesters each of real analysis and senior algebra plus another advanced
course. International F1 applicants are eligible. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the linked 2027 GraduateCAS application, complete all four quadrants, request three referees, upload
academic records, and arrange required Math GRE or obtain an approved waiver. No departmental pre-review
is available. Resolve English eligibility; departmental submission deadlines override portal dates. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor consent required by the admissions checklist. Sottile explicitly welcomes prospective students to
contact him and review his student information page. Faculty availability otherwise unconfirmed. [s1] [s26]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
2026-27 Liaison help verified. Program-specific questions may include additional essays; plain text boxes strip
elaborate formatting. Red-asterisk documents required; uploaded files cannot be replaced after submission.
Use Statuses/Check Status for progress. [s5]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Department application link explicitly points to texasam 2027 GraduateCAS. December 15 deadline and
departmental stipend are standing and not explicitly labeled 2027. Central ELP/new assistantship policies
current to 2026. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
December 15 for fall full consideration, on the standing page linked to the 2027 portal; no explicit year/time or
separate letter grace period given. Submit complete materials by then. Later materials are not guaranteed
review; contact math-gstudies@tamu.edu before a late application. The applicant-selected referee due date is
a reminder, not an extension. [s1] [s2] [s5]

Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Automatic consideration with application; use December 15 full-consideration deadline. No separate initial
funding deadline published. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required scores should arrive for December 15 full consideration. Central catalog recommends testing at least
eight weeks before the relevant deadline; late results are not assured review. Math GRE waiver requests go to
grad.director.math@tamu.edu with name, application ID and reason. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No explicit Fall 2027 offer-acceptance deadline located. First offers usually mid-February; possible later round
late April is a decision timeline, not the commitment deadline. [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Central current catalog: TOEFL iBT new 4.5 overall/4.0 each (old overall80), Essentials8.5, IELTS6.0, GRE
verbal146 or specified GMAT alternatives. Scores officially reported; English tests valid two years. Math page
retains old TOEFL80, Essentials8.5, IELTS6 and mentions PTE without current central agreement; do not rely on
PTE without confirmation. ETS code6003; no MyBest. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Completed US bachelor's meets central admission language requirement. Department still says all BA years
must be in the US and a US master's is insufficient, whereas central accepts bachelor's or higher. Pending
degree is not explicitly covered. After admission, the department must request Alternative Verification for
registration using official degree-conferral records. For teaching, an all-coursework-in-US bachelor's can
support Alternative Certification; central certification-before-hire rule supersedes the department's loose
first-semester wording. Confirm transfer/study-abroad credits and expected-degree timing. [s1] [s4] [s10]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed as required for PhD; required for the separate MS. GRE verbal146 can meet central admission English
criteria. Policy on optional general scores in PhD selection is not explicit. [s1] [s2] [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Required for PhD, within five years of receipt; official ETS6003. Waiver possible for a suitable reason that
prevents completion before deadline; email grad.director.math@tamu.edu with name, application ID and
explanation. GMAT is not a substitute. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Transcripts and degree statements from every senior-level institution; community-college records exempt.
Unofficial copies may be uploaded for review; redact Social Security number. International-language records
need originals plus official English translation. After admission/enrollment intent, official records must reach
Admissions before registration. [s1] [s3]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]

Program Materials; prerequisites are assessed through transcripts. [s1] [s2]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, written and electronically submitted by the referees themselves, from people able to assess
mathematical ability. [s1]

Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra initial recommendation specified for automatic departmental support. Additional materials for
nominated fellowships are award-specific and not established for 2027. [s2] [s6] [s9]
What sends the invitation [2027 confirmed]

Completed recommendations cannot be removed/replaced. Re-send a pending request through its edit control.

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Department advertises $2,350/month; support page specifies nine paid fall/spring months, yielding $21,150
academic-year stipend (calculated). First summer support is guaranteed, but amount not specified; subsequent
summers depend on standing and funds. Tuition/required fees covered for eligible PhD GAs. New university
floor effective October 1 2026 is $2,000/month at 50%FTE, below the advertised departmental rate; neither is
a confirmed Fall 2027 offer. [s6] [s7] [s8] [qrt1]

Years of support [Conflict]
Recruitment page advertises six years in good standing; support page specifies tuition/fees for first11
non-summer semesters and resident-rate eligibility for first21 semesters. Clarify the apparent
six-year/11-semester difference in the offer. [s6] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International doctoral applicants are considered for departmental assistantships. Teaching requires English
certification; a qualifying US bachelor's offers an alternative-certification route. Some
external/program-specific fellowships have citizenship restrictions. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good academic standing, TA duties (tutoring, recitations/labs, grading or own course) and certification.
University50%FTE assistantship is20hours/week; employee insurance eligibility requires at least50%FTE
and4.5months. Tuition/required fees for PhD teaching/research/lecturer assistantships are mandated;

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate department support application; all qualifying applicants automatically considered unless they
indicate independent/sponsored funding. Department nominates for selected fellowships. [s2] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Carl Pearcy entering fellowships, college merit fellowships, research-grant assistantships/summer support and
centrally nominated Doctoral Research Excellence opportunities. Verify current citizenship conditions and
nomination dates rather than treating historical diversity/LSAMP listings as universal eligibility. [s6] [s9]

$114 international; $89 domestic, nonrefundable, per Math PhD page. Central international admissions lists a
